name: Acetamide
description: Acetamide (CAS 60-35-5 ), also known as acetic acid amide, is the simplest aliphatic amide and functions as a solvent, plasticizer, and chemical intermediate across pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and biotechnology manufacturing. With FEMA number 4251 , it is recognized in flavoring applications and serves as a building block for synthesis of more complex amide-based compounds in various industrial processes. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, acetamide acts as a reaction intermediate and catalyst precursor in the synthesis of active pharmaceutical ingredients requiring specific amide bond formation during the production cycle. Personal care formulators use it as a humectant and surface-modifying agent in skin conditioning products, where it supports moisture retention at the formulation level for high-quality cosmetic goods. Biotechnology applications include its use as a buffering component and nitrogen source in microbial culture media and biochemical assay systems used for research and development purposes. In specialty chemical synthesis, it functions as a catalyst precursor and pH-regulating agent in controlled reaction environments to ensure consistent results across different manufacturing batches. Acetamide is supplied as a white crystalline solid or powder. Standard commercial grades include technical and pharmaceutical-grade material, with purity levels typically ranging from 98% to 99%+. Packaging is available in laboratory quantities through to bulk industrial supply to meet both R&D and production-scale procurement requirements for global chemical distribution networks.
